Official: https://github.com/RVC-Boss/GPT-SoVITS
Vendored source snapshot; see Git history for SubFlow compatibility patches.
SubFlow adds pure-Python jieba fallback and isolated CPU environment installation.
SubFlow serializes API model operations in workers, preserving responsive health checks and cancellation ownership.
Reference features are keyed by file content and prompt language, with preprocessing rollback and model-change invalidation.
Inference validates numeric inputs and reports empty speech or cancellation instead of fabricating silence.
Model replacement is staged with deferred configuration writes, preserving serving state on load or publication failure.
Committed model generations are exposed to clients, pinning synthesis and invalidating stale audio caches after reloads.
Waveform conversion saturates positive PCM16 peaks, rejects non-finite samples, and preserves input tensors and output-rate pause timing.
OGG worker errors and AAC child-process failures propagate instead of returning empty successful responses.
Original license and authorship notices are retained.
Large model weights and Python environments are downloaded separately, not committed.
